rule: State organisational units, state funds and similar institutions hold accounts at the Czech National Bank (bank code 0710) under Act 218/2000 Sb. If the recipient name or message claims one of these institutions and the account is elsewhere, raise pay.state_claim_bank_mismatch (Caution explainer). 0710 never proves who owns an account. Municipal bodies bank commercially and are excluded.
sources: ČNB — who can hold an account at ČNB: https://www.cnb.cz/cs/casto-kladene-dotazy/Ucty-komu-muze-CNB-vest-ucet-informace-pro-klienty/
